words: The lowest and the highest credit allowed for the tier. Below the floor, give the floor. Never go above the max.
Credits end in 8 (RM 48, RM 118). Take the highest one at or below your result.
Giving a player two rewards on the same day. Not allowed.

tour.label: When
tour.title: Is this player due a birthday credit?
items: Birthday Reward Claimed This Year = No
tour.done: All three: carry on to the steps.
tour.notYet: Tick all three. Any "no" means no birthday credit today.

tour.label: Do
tour.title: Five steps, in this order
items: Skip on any yes: claimed this year, risk tag, same-day reward.
Has a Secret Wallet? SW base. No SW? Deposit base.
Work out the amount. The Numbers card does it for you.
Set the turnover and tell the player the validity.
Claimed This Year = Yes, then update the QA Record.

tour.label: Never
tour.title: Three hard stops
items: Stack it with a same-day Reload, Compensation or LTV reward.
Promise an amount before the eligibility check.

tour.label: Numbers
tour.title: Work out the amount
tour.secLabel: Step 3 and 4, the base and sizing

bases.label: No SW
bases.confirm: [CONFIRM] Which deposit figure: last month's deposit or total deposit? The SOP says both.

tour.label: Approver
tour.title: Who can issue it?
tour.q: Is the Total Deposit RM 100,000 or more?
tour.yes: ATL or above only. The ATL confirms value, claim history, risk tag and amount, then tags "Birthday Credit - ATL Reviewed".
tour.no: CS issues it, within the tier cap.

pool.q: Tier V player has a Secret Wallet of RM 400. What birthday credit do you issue?
pool.why: 400 x 30% = 120. Use the highest amount ending in 8 at or below it: RM 118. Deduct from SW, 1x turnover.

pool.q: Tier 3 player, no Secret Wallet. The deposit-base amount works out to RM 10 (0.1% of RM 10,000). What do you issue?
pool.why: RM 10 is below the Tier 3 floor. Issue the floor, RM 38, with 3x turnover.

pool.q: A player's Total Deposit is RM 150,000. Who issues the birthday credit?
o: ATL or above, tagged ATL Reviewed
pool.why: RM 100,000 or more goes to the ATL or above. CS cannot issue it directly.

pool.q: The player received a Reload bonus this morning. Their birthday is today. What do you do?
pool.why: No stacking with a same-day Reload, Compensation or LTV reward. Skip.

pool.q: The player has a Secret Wallet. Which turnover applies?
pool.why: SW base: deduct from SW, 1x turnover. The deposit base is 3x with no deduction.

pool.q: The SW figure you have is from yesterday. What do you do first?
o: Refresh the SW today, then size
pool.why: A stale SW is not a valid base. Refresh it the same day before sizing.
